lead_raw_text:
The structure of Al₆Zr₂ (reduced formula Al₃Zr) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mbm (No. 15), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives both Al and Zr centers a 12-neighbor, close-packed-like local arrangement: each Al is surrounded by 8 Al and 4 Zr neighbors, while each Zr has 12 Al neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.81 to 2.94 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connects all eight sites in a single component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts show Al–Al 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Al–Zr pairs sharing corners and edges.
